format: WSDC Registry Events, result posting and corrections

source.edition: Version 2026.1C (page footers; the file name says 2026.1B)
source.quote_free_summary: Registry Events must post contest results at the event, open to all competitors for at least 30 days; results include contest rounds, placements and score reports (judges may be listed anonymously); if results are inaccurate, corrected results must be posted.

requirement: A WSDC profile must keep results (rounds, placements, score reports) open to all competitors for a minimum of 30 days and must post corrected results when results are inaccurate.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. A PROFILE-ACTIVATION BLOCKER for the named body. Docs-only record; no compliance claimed. Not authorized: engine, SQL, UI, report generation.
interpretation_notes: The text does NOT address temporarily removing a posted result while it is investigated, so permission to hide is NOT assumed. A WSDC profile needs a clearly marked under-review presentation that preserves the required access (for example the original score report remains visible but flagged) and this REQUIRES INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION before WSDC profile activation. Also not stated: who may judge a result inaccurate, a deadline for corrected results, and whether a hidden-then-corrected result satisfies the 30 days.
applicable_event_versions: Version 2026.1C (page footers; the file name says 2026.1B)
decision_refs: OD-22 (owner decision 2026-11-23: Option B for initial Studio/Custom; Option A for future WSDC support, with UCWDC correction-authority restrictions; retrospective audit PR #795)
